dispatcharr.setup.copy.value: Enter your Dispatcharr server's address and the username and password you sign in to it with. This TV keeps an API key, never your password.
dispatcharr.setup.copy.description: Setup screen explanation beside the sign-in form

dispatcharr.setup.address.description: Setup field label: the server's address

dispatcharr.setup.address_example.description: Placeholder in the empty address field: an example address after a translated lead-in

dispatcharr.setup.empty_field.description: Placeholder in an empty username or password field

dispatcharr.setup.plaintext.description: Note under an http:// address: credentials are not encrypted on the network

dispatcharr.setup.missing.description: Setup: Sign in pressed with a field left empty

dispatcharr.setup.bad_address.value: That is not a server address. Try one like 192.168.1.10:9191.
dispatcharr.setup.bad_address.description: Setup failure: the address typed is not a server address

dispatcharr.setup.unreachable.value: Nothing answered at that address. Check it, and that the server is running.
dispatcharr.setup.unreachable.description: Setup failure: nothing answered at the address

dispatcharr.setup.not_dispatcharr.value: Something answered at that address, but it is not Dispatcharr.
dispatcharr.setup.not_dispatcharr.description: Setup failure: the address answered but is not Dispatcharr

dispatcharr.setup.forbidden.value: The server refused this TV. Check Dispatcharr's network access settings.
dispatcharr.setup.forbidden.description: Setup failure: 403, the server's network policy refuses this TV

dispatcharr.setup.throttled.value: Too many attempts. Wait a minute, then try again.
dispatcharr.setup.throttled.description: Setup failure: 429, too many sign-in attempts

dispatcharr.setup.unavailable.value: The server is busy. Try again in a moment.
dispatcharr.setup.unavailable.description: Setup failure: 503, the server is up but busy

dispatcharr.setup.unexpected.value: The server gave an unexpected answer ({detail}).
dispatcharr.setup.unexpected.description: Setup failure: any other answer; {detail} is a short technical description such as HTTP 500

dispatcharr.setup.save_failed.value: Signed in, but this TV could not save the sign-in.
dispatcharr.setup.save_failed.description: Setup failure: signed in but the sign-in could not be stored

dispatcharr.setup.signed_in_as.description: Under the connected verdict: {server} is the server's address, {username} the account

dispatcharr.setup.channels.description: Under the connected verdict: how many channels the account can watch

dispatcharr.setup.channels_failed.value: The channel list could not be read.
dispatcharr.setup.channels_failed.description: Under the connected verdict: the channel list could not be read

dispatcharr.setup.until_reboot.value: Saved only until this TV restarts.
dispatcharr.setup.until_reboot.description: Note under the connected verdict: the sign-in was saved only until the TV restarts
